name: iota-dashboard
description: Online dashboard for IOTA Train at Home miner status, deployed on Cloudflare Pages

scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=iota-miner-tools && node --test packages/iota-miner-tools/test/*.test.mjs && npm run test:local-tools
scripts.test:local-tools: python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 9) else 1)' && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -v || echo '跳过本地工具测试（需要 macOS 与 Python 3.9+）'
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist/web
